issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents: the UML diagram in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, while the solution implementation declares it as returning int. This inconsistency will confuse students about the expected return type (the task text even instructs to check the UML for the expected type) and may cause mismatches with automated tests or reference solutions.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type for getTotalNumberOfStudents across the materials. Recommended fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md (line 70) to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int so it matches the solution implementation and the natural numeric meaning of the method. Alternatively, if the exercise intends a String return, change the solution implementation to return String and adapt its implementation and tests accordingly. Also update the task description that references the UML to avoid ambiguity.
